install_configuration.reason: Otherwise req_llm loads a .env file from the working directory when its application starts under Mix.

contract: Anthropic Messages API provider of integration/ai-text through req_llm 1.30's documented provider-callback API: anthropic-version 2026-10-21, max_retries 0, one HTTP exchange with every response halted by an Elzoo step (no redirect, no retry, no req_llm error value); key only from the injected Need as api_key; sampling not declared; structured output through output_config.format; cache hint mapped to cache_control markers (system and tools, at most one message, 5m or 1h) or refused, a message breakpoint marking exactly the named message at its index in req_llm's wire list (each run of consecutive tool results one message) and a tool result before the end of its run refused unsupported_feature; image input declared: a user parts message as one message of text and base64 image blocks in order, refused unsupported_feature for a model whose llm_db input modalities lack image or a cache breakpoint on the parts message, and too_large for an image over the documented 10 MB base64 limit; usage and cache counters from the raw usage map with absent fields :unknown; documented error statuses mapped to the interface's failure tags.
limits: Stub evidence only (R5): conformance to the pinned documented format, never current live behaviour, cache hits or savings, output quality, latency or rate limits; a periodic live check is a later owner decision.

Requests are validated against a schema hand-derived from named sections of Anthropic's documentation fetched 2026-11-09, and for the base64 image block fetched 2026-11-24; no official machine-readable specification was found; conformance beyond the documented examples is not claimed.
req_llm accepts anthropic-version 2026-10-21 only as a header override; compatibility of its encoder with that version rests on the listed schema-validated scenarios.

Sampling, structured output together with tools, provider-executed tools, document input, URL or file-ID image sources, a cache breakpoint inside a parts message, streaming and batch are refused or not supplied in this slice.

The message breakpoint's wire index models req_llm 1.30.0's merge of consecutive tool results and its marking of a message's last block; a later req_llm that encodes differently needs this rule checked again.

Image input: stub evidence of the documented format as fetched 2026-11-24, not live behaviour, image understanding, image token counts or pricing; image tokens are in the input counters as reported, no image counter; pixel dimensions are not checked; a model or size refusal comes after integration/ai-text has read the artifacts; a model added later needs its own evidence.
Tenants sharing one Anthropic key share Anthropic's prompt cache; configure one credential per tenant where isolation matters.

Every consumer must merge config :req_llm, load_dotenv: false into its configuration: the line is declared in install_configuration and written into the generated install file, but the copier never edits a consumer's configuration. The repository's copied-consumer harness writes the line and checks that it is set before req_llm starts in the aggregate consumer; a hand-copied consumer that drops the line is not checked. The credential invariant holds regardless: only the injected key is used.

Receive-time collector retains at most 4 MiB of wire body bytes after HTTP framing; the last received chunk may coexist with the accumulator. Overflow discards the body and stops reception. This does not bound BEAM heap, TLS or kernel buffers. Compressed bodies stay encoded as before. Oversized non-2xx responses retain status fallback and retry metadata.

grounding.claim: Every captured stub request is validated with jsv against this schema hand-derived from Anthropic's Messages API reference, Prompt caching, Versions and Migrating to API version 2026-10-21 (fetched 2026-11-09) and, for the base64 image block, ImageBlockParam, Base64ImageSource and Vision (fetched 2026-11-24), plus method, path, the pinned version header, the injected key and absent sampling fields. Not an official specification; conformance beyond the documented examples is not claimed.

Listed scenarios against in-process function-plug stubs in Anthropic's documented formats: the interface conformance kit; the golden wire request of each kit scenario recorded before image input; image scenarios (the kit's image_input with the PNG decoded from the wire, each media type, eight images in order, a ninth image and images over max_image_bytes and max_total_image_bytes refused by integration/ai-text with no request, a model without image input and a breakpoint on the parts message refused with no request, the documented base64 size limit on both sides through translate/2, the largest max_image_bytes image sent); usage and cache counters (cold write, warm read, mixed TTL, below minimum, absent fields, partial breakdowns, disagreeing totals); tool-result error flag on the wire; cache-hint and reasoning translation and refusals before any request; a message breakpoint on the last tool result of a run and on the message after it, with and without image parts, marked at its wire index, and one on a tool result inside its run refused with no request; documented error statuses and a redirect with one request each; transport timeout with one request; malformed 2xx; redaction in results, inspect, owner state, debug logs and req_llm telemetry; ambient keys never used across a req_llm restart with a .env file; source audit of this Piece's own manifest-listed files; the README's Install configuration section carries the exact config line. Finite scenarios, no live call, not proofs.

Finite receive-time boundary checks: actual loopback HTTP with withheld terminal marker returns early for overflow; actual callback byte counts are at most cap plus last chunk with prior accumulator at most cap; disabling the collector waits for completion; actual provider wiring returns early. Exactly-cap and cap-minus-one valid Messages JSON decode unchanged, oversized error status fallback and retry metadata persist, gzip bodies retain raw-capture semantics, and each provider scenario sends one request. No live provider call or heap-memory proof.

req_llm 1.30.0 (Hex checksum 1c4b19608aa982de5ea396cc6de3d3738e72480182ba11c184e028a4af305edb) Anthropic request encoding, model resolution, authentication and version headers and the documented provider-callback API prepare_request/4 plus Req.request/1; observations of the pinned version (probe transcripts in the task work record), not guarantees.
llm_db 2026.11.0 model metadata used by req_llm for model resolution and reasoning encoding.
Req 0.7.5 response and error steps, Req.Request.halt/2 and the :plug test transport.
Anthropic's live API behaves as its documentation describes; a 429 or 529 meaning 'before generation' is named only and authorizes nothing; the host keeps the key Need truthful.

telemetry.contract: No Elzoo event. req_llm may emit its request start event (payload capture off by default) to consumer-installed handlers; response-side events are not emitted because every response is halted. Own events through runtime/telemetry: future task.

config.contract: Construction-time provider term (optional HTTPS base URL; a test plug), fixed API version 2026-10-21, max_retries 0, receive timeout from the interface Config, key from the injected Need; no hot reconfiguration.

control.contract: Call-scoped; dispatch, rearm and expiry are the delivery/effect-intent owner's Control.
